_comment: The Thought Journal's report insights (core/thought_report.py). Each is a pattern in what she recorded, shown only once MIN_RECORDS finished records have the values behind it. Never a cause, never advice, never a judgement of a thought. {placeholders} are filled in by the code.
locked: Keep going to see your patterns: {n} more finished record{s} with before and after ratings will show them.

insights.belief_drop: Your belief in the first thought tended to drop by about {drop} points after working through it.
insights.belief_same: Your belief in the first thought tended to stay about where it was. That happens, and noticing it still counts.
insights.emotion_drop: The feelings you rated tended to ease by about {drop} points out of 100.
insights.trap: "{trap}" was the thinking pattern you noticed most.
insights.against: When you wrote evidence against the thought, your belief tended to drop more ({with_} against {without} points).
insights.balanced: The balanced thoughts you wrote tended to feel about {belief}% believable.

pattern: Thoughts about "{tag}" with "{trap}" came back {n} times with the belief staying high.
empty_section: No thought records in this period
